A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the ATLAS-based implementation of EKF-SLAM NFT on the Maestro chip is capable of tracking up to 1000 targets at 10 Hz while maintaining a 2D position accuracy of 1 meter and 1 degree heading accuracy.
the EKF NFT algorithm is capable of operating at high rates while maintaining acceptable accuracies as the number of features increases.
the EKF SLAM algorithm can be ported and run at a rate of 1,000 Hz on a single Maestro chip while providing the same performance as the RAD750.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Maestro chip can provide significant performance improvement over the RAD750 for the EKF SLAM algorithm.
by leveraging the floating point capabilities of the Maestro chip, it is possible to achieve the performance required by the EKF SLAM algorithm while maintaining the required accuracies.
the EKF SLAM algorithm can be implemented to run on the OPERA platform at a high enough rate to provide acceptable accuracy for a variety of target complexities.
